📖 How to use

  1. Pick metric or imperial units.
  2. Enter your trip distance, vehicle efficiency and fuel price.
  3. Read the fuel needed, total trip cost and cost per mile/km instantly.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What is the difference between MPG and L/100km?

MPG (miles per gallon) rises with efficiency; L/100km falls with efficiency. Pick whichever your car's dashboard shows.

How do I convert my car's numbers?

L/100km = 235.214 ÷ MPG, and MPG = 235.214 ÷ L/100km. The tool handles each system separately.

Does this include tolls or wear and tear?

No, only fuel. Tolls, depreciation and maintenance are extra.
